_doc: [tunes] The song library (systems/tunes.gd). Files are audio/songs/<id>.mp3; a song whose file is missing is skipped everywhere (no CD, not on the CD player, not in the shuffle), so new MP3s can be dropped in by id later (then run an import). group: story or a planet id. kind: title / cinematic / villain (CD player only unless shuffle), playlist (background shuffle on its planet), night (only at night on its planet), restored (only once its planet is mostly restored). unlock: start (owned from the start) or cd (a CD found in the rubble on found_on). artist: an id in artists. Names, titles, genres, bios and descs are English and translated at display time (tr). artist home: the planet the artist lived on; every intact CD is found on its artist's home planet (found_on). scratched: rare one-play teaser CDs of songs you do not own yet, per_planet of them on each planet (planet/cd_finds.gd). State: GameState.flags.songs {found, pity, pending, scratched (held), scratch_left, scratch_cool, plays}.

artists.name: The Cradle Farewell Orchestra
artists.bio: Played one last concert on the launch pad while the ark boarded. Half of them missed the flight on purpose, so the encore was very long.

artists.name: The Compactors
artists.bio: A four-piece that rehearsed inside a broken trash compactor for the acoustics. They swear the walls only closed in on them once, during a drum solo.

artists.name: Lil' Rustbucket
artists.bio: A retired sweeper bot who refused to stop making beats. Every track was recorded on its own diagnostic beeper, between error codes.

artists.name: DJ Recycle Bin
artists.bio: Only samples sounds from the city dump: lids, crinkles, a fridge door with real soul. Released three albums and never once got out of bed for them.

artists.name: Professor Pianissimo
artists.bio: Composes only for empty rooms and sleeping cities. His neighbours filed forty-one noise complaints, all saying the music was too soft to hear properly.

artists.name: Two Suns Tango Orchestra
artists.bio: Ochre's hardest-working band: with two suns there is no shade and no siesta, so they just kept playing. The sunglasses are part of the uniform.

artists.name: The Mirage Brothers
artists.bio: Nobody is sure how many Mirage Brothers there are. On a hot day the crowd counted seven; on a cold one, just Gary.

artists.name: The Salty Buoys
artists.bio: A beach band that played on floating junk rafts, drifting between islands mid-song. Their tour schedule depended entirely on the tide.

artists.name: Barnacle Bossa Trio
artists.bio: Three mellow players who refused to evacuate until the set was finished. The set was four hours long. They caught the last pod, still humming.

artists.name: Static & the Streetlights
artists.bio: A synth duo who powered their gigs by plugging into whichever harbour lamp still worked. The power company billed them for the whole ice shelf.

artists.name: Mittens McKenzie
artists.bio: Rime's beloved pianist, who played every concert in mittens. Critics called it muffled genius. Mittens called it frostbite prevention.

artists.name: Smelter Skelter
artists.bio: Brooding Anvil band who tuned their drums to the furnace roar. The Ledger tried to buy their catalogue; they melted the contract down and played the slag.

artists.name: Ledger Brand Audio
artists.bio: The Ledger's in-house jingle studio. Every song is copyrighted, trademarked and billed per listen. Credited as "Ledger Brand Audio, all rights extracted".

songs.title: Greenfall (Main Theme)
songs.desc: The song the Makers hummed on the way to the ark. Hopeful, a little lonely.

songs.title: The Fall of LM-1
songs.desc: Meteors, alarms, one small pod falling. Then quiet piano.

songs.title: The Ledger
songs.desc: Ticking clocks and detuned bass. Sounds expensive.
